{{Top|leg}}
'''Ion exciters''' were parts of a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] unit in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. After [[Andur Sunrider]] had burned one out by jumping through a [[Magnetic storm/Legends|magnetic storm]], [[A-3DO]] had to replace it in order to render the hyperdrive of the ''[[Lightside Explorer]]'' operational.
